dict.string: Loffty listens to system audio so the notch soundwaves match what is actually playing
Loffty intercepts volume and brightness keys to replace system HUD for these settings, and reads notification banners for the notch

Loffty controls Messages to send replies from the notch, favourites the current track in Music, and controls your browser to identify the website of the video now playing so it can show that site’s icon
